711090201.text: Whoa, who knew that such a big secret could have been hidden in this run-down Hall...

711090204.text: Also, Paimon doesn't think Huang the Third knew about this place either... Hold on, could this be the actual "Guhua Treasure Chamber" recorded in the legends?

711090205.text: #Also, {NICKNAME}, look over there! Paimon spies something glowing on that platform!

711090501.text: "...The heavens are unfaithful, and those who seek its blessing and gain audience are rare. Fate is capricious, and those whose prosperity endures are few... They who are favored often find their paths barred, and worse awaits those who are not..."

711090502.text: "...This monument was left to ask this of future generations. When you have reached a dead end, what shall you do?"

711090601.text: Huh? This sword seems to have something written on it. Let Paimon see...

711090602.text: "...Caressing the blade, singing I go, to cleave dragons and drink their blood. The divine light, like flowing lightning, like a frigid wave, threatens to smash the mountains..."

711090603.text: "...Beneath Mt. Tianheng, I slay tigers, the scaled beast I skewer amidst the Sea of Clouds... When I return crowned in success, we shall live at ease..."

711090604.text: There's also a stone tablet next to it... Eh? The handwriting below seems to be different...

711090605.text: "...I originally wanted to leave behind some delicacies here. But the food would inevitably spoil over time, so I left the recipes here for you to cook instead. I assure you, they shall be delicious indeed."

711090606.text: "...Apart from these, nothing else remains. Only this sword and the beautiful scenery."

711090607.text: "...When faced with a dead end, what should we do? You already know the answer."

711090608.text: "...Do not take... treasure, leaving solely one... henceforth..."

711090609.text: May my final stand... be a monument...

711090610.text: Whoa... These lines here are so illegible that Paimon can't understand it one bit!

711090613.text: *sob* After all this, we didn't find a single valuable treasure. All that hope for nothing...

711092501.text: Sigh... To think that after a thousand years of heritage, the Guhua Clan's head doorkeeper must cheat others to survive... What shall we do, what can be done...

711092502.text: Ugh... Alright, come on now. Am I not sparing my junior from starving to death while guarding our gates...?

711092503.text: #And don't look at me like that. You're always depressed... But you were pleased to see {NICKNAME}'s performance just now, weren't you?

711092504.text: That fool from before? They get to take a look around for making you some rice with bacon? And I would be pleased about that? I would slap you to death if I were a few years younger...

711092505.text: Heh! Your technique was inferior to mine just a few years ago!

711092506.text: ...Anyway, listen... Only a few of us geezers are left. What do you plan to do after we stop testing those who may be destined to join us? Take those books with us to our graves?

711092508.text: Hah... Just forget it. What's the point of saying such depressing things?

711092509.text: Oh, why don't you try the food those kids made me? Hehe! I think it's better than Wanmin Restaurant's fare! Here, take a bite! Just a bite!

711099902.text: Yay! We've managed to lower the water level. Let's go see what's inside!
